# Phase 10 review notes (diagnostics), binding for reviewers, skeptics and fixers

Phase 10 moves `src/doctor.rs` (927 lines) and the diagnostic / debug-logs parts of `src/cli.rs` into the registered
module `diagnostics`. Behaviour must not change: stdout and stderr bytes and their ORDER, exit codes, files written
(bytes, modes), process spawns (count, argv, order, timing), the `logs/*.log` text, clap identifiers.

Read, in this order: `docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-10-diagnostics.md` (the design, sections 1-17), then
`target/p10/design-errata.md` (amendments; where a step prompt and the old design differ, the step prompt and the
errata win), then `target/p10/steps.json` (the step briefs), then the recon notes `target/p10/recon-*.md` (git-ignored).
The original code is `git show phase10-start:src/doctor.rs` and `git show phase10-start:src/cli.rs`
(`phase10-start` = `b0fe04d`; before step 10.0 has created the tag use `b0fe04d`).

The design deviations (13) are accepted: CheckFix::InstallMissingIntegrations (not ReinstallIntegrations);
SystemFacts is the env group's snapshot; RestartReminderRepository gets is_pending / clear_pending (insert false,
keep the key); settings reset and data-dir creation are plain std::fs in FileRepairs; more ports and bridges than the
plan's four; extra VOs; Integration derives PartialEq, Eq; no cfg(windows) in domain / application;
`doctor_script_bins_skip_orphans` moves to the bootstrap bridge tests; `doctor_group_soft_fix_abort` is split (the
policy half keeps the name in doctor_run.rs, the flow half is `doctor_group_soft_fix_abort_flow`); `cli` and
`doctor` stay in LEGACY_MODULES; LaunchPolicy is not reused; `diagnostics` reaches specs and the installer only
through bootstrap bridges.

THE hard property: doctor is LAZY. Check, for every change, that:
1. a group is BUILT (its construction I/O: which(), pwsh $PROFILE spawn, bash login-file stats, settings load + warn
   log, which("fish")) only after the previous group passed, and BEFORE its header is printed (--all);
2. each check's facts are asked only when that check is evaluated; Skip checks and checks after an abort are never
   evaluated; a fix is followed by a fresh evaluation of that one check (the dotfile LIST is a snapshot, not re-listed);
3. the settings are loaded ONCE per run, when the environment group is built;
4. sw_vers / bash --version / fish --version spawn only when their turn comes;
5. the order of reporter events equals the order of the old println!/eprint! calls.

Test lock: every existing #[test] keeps its fn name and assertions. Allowed restructurings only: the five tests in
design section 13 (and the 3 `load_or_defaults` tests re-homed in 10.18b). `python3 -B scripts/hexagonal-refactor/testlock.py .
ef807c1` and `. phase10-start` must show MISSING 0 and DUPLICATE 0. New test names must be unique tree-wide.

Architecture: domain = std only (no anyhow / serde / clap / cfg / fs / env / Command / thread / println);
application = no infrastructure, no cfg; ports in application/ports with `#[cfg(test)]` doubles; anyhow, clap and
serde_json only in infrastructure/cli (+ bootstrap); `IntegrationInstaller`, `InstallSpecBundleUseCase`,
`embedded_spec_bundle`, `FileDotfileRepository` only in bootstrap; everything pub(crate) at most; one type per
snake_case file; mod.rs only declares children; no glob re-exports; no new crates; Cargo files untouched.
`scripts/hexagonal-refactor/phase10-greps.sh` encodes these (A and E1 FAIL until 10.18a on purpose).

Known and accepted: the manual smoke (real terminal spinner, Ctrl-C, colours, Windows) is the user's; clippy budget is
4 on Linux with no headroom (items of test doubles carry their own #[cfg(test)], never `#![cfg(test)]`).

steps.title: Guards: tag, Windows check, greps and doctor-diff scripts, register diagnostics, commit the design
steps.prompt:
Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/agent-brief.md and docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-10-diagnostics.md first (sections 1, 10, 14; section 14 = rules for every step: skills, gate, commit format), and target/p10/design-errata.md (amendments to the design; the step prompts already carry the final wording, where they differ from the old design text the prompts win). Goal: guards and registration only; no production code moves.
1. `git tag phase10-start b0fe04d` (local tag, skip if it exists). The design doc docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-10-diagnostics.md and scripts/hexagonal-refactor/doctor-diff.sh are untracked in the tree: this step commits them.
2. Windows check: try `rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` and `apt-get install -y gcc-mingw-w64-x86-64` (outbound HTTPS works through the proxy; if either fails, record why and continue). Then ONCE, before changing anything, run `cargo check --locked --all-targets --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` and report green or not. gate.sh runs this check by itself only when both the target and x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc exist and prints NOTHING about Windows otherwise, so a missing 'windows: ok' line is not a verdict.
3. Scripts: copy target/p10/phase10-greps.sh and target/p10/phase10-literals.py to scripts/hexagonal-refactor/ (chmod +x the .sh; it finds the .py through $(dirname "$0")). If target/p10 is missing, write them from section 15 of the design (groups A..G, Z; model: scripts/hexagonal-refactor/phase9-greps.sh, but its prod() must cut only at a column-0 `#[cfg(test)] mod`, not at the first #[cfg(test)]). Add the existing untracked scripts/hexagonal-refactor/doctor-diff.sh. Run `scripts/hexagonal-refactor/phase10-greps.sh`: the A group FAILs on purpose until 10.18a. Commit: `chore(scripts): add the Phase 10 greps and the doctor diff`.
4. Prove the net at the start: `cargo build --locked`, then `scripts/hexagonal-refactor/doctor-diff.sh target/debug/tabsmith > target/p10/doctor-diff.start.txt` (about 3.5 min; needs cc and python3) and `cmp target/p10/doctor-diff.start.txt target/p10/doctor-diff.baseline.txt`. They must be identical. If the baseline file is missing, produce it from target/hexagonal-refactor/baseline-tree/target/debug/tabsmith. If they differ, STOP and report (never re-baseline).
5. Register the module: create src/diagnostics/mod.rs containing exactly `pub(crate) mod application;`, `pub(crate) mod domain;`, `pub(crate) mod infrastructure;` and EMPTY src/diagnostics/{domain,application,infrastructure}/mod.rs; add `mod diagnostics;` to src/main.rs after `mod completion;` (keep `mod cli;` and `mod doctor;` until 10.18a; no `use` in main.rs); add "diagnostics" to REGISTERED_MODULES in src/architecture_tests.rs (alphabetical, after "completion"). The registration and the folder MUST be in the same commit (rust_files panics on a registered module without its folder). Pre-check with `scripts/hexagonal-refactor/fitness-mod.sh --worktree diagnostics`. Commit: `refactor(diagnostics): register the module in the fitness test`.
6. Fold target/p10/design-errata.md into docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-10-diagnostics.md (edit the sections it names: LogPaths and the two-method ShowRecentLogsUseCase, CheckFix::marks_restart_reminder, run_doctor_command taking a module builder, first_line_of, the added tests, the cfg(test)-per-item and clippy rule in section 14, the C9 trap row), then commit the design doc: `docs: add the Phase 10 diagnostics design`.
7. Full gate: `BASELINE_CLIPPY=4 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/gate.sh` must print GATE PASS. Report: windows check result, doctor-diff cmp result, phase10-greps labels (which FAIL and why), gate lines, commit hashes.

steps.title: shell_integration: Integration PartialEq/Eq and RestartReminderRepository is_pending/clear_pending
steps.prompt:
Read agent-brief.md and phase-10-diagnostics.md (sections 4, 5, 12 deviation 3, 13, 14) first. Legacy: `git show phase10-start:src/doctor.rs` lines 247-268 (the epilogue). Test-first: write the failing tests, then the implementation, then run the gate and commit (commit after GREEN; a red tree must never be committed).
1. `Integration` (src/shell_integration/domain/entities/integration.rs, derive on line ~8 is `Clone, Debug`): add `PartialEq, Eq` (add the derive to IntegrationPhase too if it lacks it; Shell, PathBuf and Option are Eq). Test: should_compare_integrations_by_shell_path_and_phase.
2. `RestartReminderRepository` (src/shell_integration/domain/repositories/restart_reminder_repository.rs) gains `fn is_pending(&self) -> bool;` and `fn clear_pending(&self);` (NOT find/delete: the plan's wording would remove the key and change the bytes of state.json). The #[cfg(test)] InMemoryRestartReminderRepository loses its inherent `is_pending` (now a trait method) and gets `clear_pending` (sets false); its two existing tests keep their names and assertions (add `use` of the trait where a file calls the method). `StateRestartReminderRepository` implements both with the EXACT legacy semantics: is_pending = `data_directory.state_file().ok()` then `JsonDocumentStore::load(&path).ok()`, true ONLY when `map.get("doctor.prompt-restart-terminal").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()) == Some(true)` (the string 'true' or a number is NOT pending; no data root, missing file or corrupt file is false). clear_pending = the same load, and when it loads: insert the key with `false` KEEPING the key, then `let _ = s.save()` (whole state.json rewritten pretty, keys sorted, trailing newline, 0600, other keys kept); a corrupt or unloadable state is left untouched; without a data directory nothing is written.
3. New tests (unique names; check `git grep -n 'fn <name>\b'`): is_pending true after save_pending; false for a new data directory, for a stored false, for the string 'true', for the number 1, for a corrupt file, without a data directory; clear_pending turns a saved true into a file that reads exactly `{\n  \"doctor.prompt-restart-terminal\": false\n}\n`; keeps other keys (sorted, pretty); leaves a corrupt state untouched; writes nothing without a data directory; in-memory double: pending after save, not pending after clear. Existing tests in both files stay untouched.
4. `BASELINE_CLIPPY=4 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/gate.sh` GATE PASS, testlock MISSING 0 / DUPLICATE 0 against ef807c1 and phase10-start. Commit: `refactor(shell_integration): let the restart reminder be read and cleared`. Report the CHANGED list (expected: none).

steps.title: Domain leaf value objects: CheckSeverity, InfoLine, CheckFix, CheckOutcome, OperatingSystem, ToolVersion, DiagnosticsError
steps.prompt:
Read agent-brief.md and phase-10-diagnostics.md (sections 3, 4, 12, 13, 14) and target/p10/design-errata.md first. Legacy: `git show phase10-start:src/doctor.rs` lines 52-78 (Kind, Outcome, err) and 638-647 (version_of); lines 351-355 and 432-438 for which fixes mark the restart reminder. Test-first, one type per snake_case file under src/diagnostics/domain (create domain/mod.rs children `pub(crate) mod diagnostics_error;` and `pub(crate) mod value_objects;`, plus value_objects/mod.rs; mod.rs files only declare children). Domain is std-only plus other modules' DOMAIN types: no anyhow/serde/clap/println!/std::fs/std::env/Command/cfg.
Files: value_objects/check_severity.rs (`#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] enum CheckSeverity { Normal, Soft, Skip }`, keep the doc comment of Kind); info_line.rs (`InfoLine::Text(String)` | `Command { before: String, command: String, after: String }`, the reporter paints `command` in magenta later); check_fix.rs (`CheckFix`: CreateDataDirectory(PathBuf), InstallIntegration(Integration), InstallMissingIntegrations(Vec<Shell>) [renamed from the glossary's ReinstallIntegrations: it is install-if-missing, deviation 1], ResetSettings(PathBuf), InstallSpecBundle; Clone, Debug, PartialEq) WITH `marks_restart_reminder(&self) -> bool` written as an explicit-arm match (D8, no catch-all): CreateDataDirectory false, InstallIntegration true, InstallMissingIntegrations true, ResetSettings false, InstallSpecBundle false (trap T18: the bridge in 10.16 applies the fix and then saves the reminder iff this says so; both integration fixes mark even when they installed nothing); check_outcome.rs (`CheckOutcome::{Ok, Warn(String), Err { reason: String, info: Vec<InfoLine>, fix: Option<CheckFix> }}`, Clone/Debug/PartialEq, `err(reason: impl Into<String>)` = empty info, no fix; `is_ok()`, `is_err()`); operating_system.rs (`OperatingSystem::{Linux, Macos, Windows, Other(String)}`, `from_name(&str)`: 'linux' 'macos' 'windows' else Other(name)); tool_version.rs (`ToolVersion(Vec<u32>)`; `parse(&str) -> Option<ToolVersion>` is version_of's logic VERBATIM: first token of `s.split(|c: char| !(c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '.'))` that contains '.' and starts with an ASCII digit; parts split on '.', empty parts dropped; any u32 overflow makes the WHOLE result None with no retry on a later token; `components() -> &[u32]`, `major()`, `minor_or_zero()` (the bash message uses v[0] and v.get(1).unwrap_or(&0)), `is_below(&self, bound: &[u32]) -> bool` = LEXICOGRAPHIC slice comparison, NO zero padding; `Display` = components joined by '.'); diagnostics_error.rs (`DiagnosticsError::{IntegrationPaths(ShellIntegrationError), DataDirectory(SharedError)}`; Display writes the wrapped error's Display byte for byte; `impl std::error::Error` WITHOUT a source() override, otherwise anyhow's `{:#}` prints the text twice).
Tests (NEW unique names; do NOT create `doctor_version_parsing` or any other locked name now: the legacy copies still live in doctor.rs and the locked names are created in 10.18a): ToolVersion: `GNU bash, version 3.2.57(1)-release (arm64-apple-darwin24)` -> [3,2,57]; `fish, version 3.7.1`; `Microsoft Windows [Version 10.0.19045.3803]` -> 4 numbers; `14.5\n` -> [14,5]; `3.` -> [3]; `99999999999.1` -> None; no dot -> None; first dotted token wins; is_below: [3,3] below [3,3,0], [4] below [4,4], [4,4,0] not below [4,4], [3,2,57] below [4,4]; Display '3.2.2'; major/minor_or_zero of [4]. OperatingSystem names. CheckOutcome::err has no info and no fix. CheckFix::marks_restart_reminder: one test per variant (the two integration fixes true, the other three false). DiagnosticsError: each variant's Display equals the wrapped text and `format!("{e:#}") == e.to_string()` (use ShellIntegrationError::Environment and SharedError::HomeDirectoryNotFound). Gate (GATE PASS, testlock MISSING 0 DUPLICATE 0), commit: `refactor(diagnostics): add the check value objects and tool version`.

steps.title: DoctorRun entity
steps.prompt: Read agent-brief.md and phase-10-diagnostics.md (sections 4, 8, 11 T4/T8/T9, 13, 14) first. Legacy: `git show phase10-start:src/doctor.rs` lines 110-135 (Run::outcome, Run::count) and 220-231 (counts restore, failed). Create src/diagnostics/domain/entities/{mod.rs,doctor_run.rs}: `DoctorRun::new(all: bool, strict: bool)`, `all()`, `strict()`, `effective(&self, severity: CheckSeverity, outcome: CheckOutcome) -> CheckOutcome` (a Soft Err becomes Warn(reason) unless strict, DROPPING info and fix; every other combination passes through unchanged INCLUDING a Soft Err under strict, which keeps its info and its fix: it is fixed and re-run, source-map doctor.md trap 7; write the match with explicit arms, D8: no catch-all `o => o`, use `Ok | Warn(_) | Err { .. }` arms), `count(&mut self, &CheckOutcome)` (Ok nothing, Warn warnings += 1, Err errors += 1), `abort(&mut self)` (errors += 1 DIRECTLY: an unfixed abort is not counted through count), `counts() -> (usize, usize)` (errors, warnings), `restore(&mut self, counts)` (the system group restores the counts it had), `failed() -> bool` = errors > 0 || (strict && warnings > 0).
